name: ACI-Bench-Refined
description: A refined subset of the ACI-Bench suite intended to evaluate clinical language models on clinician-authored prompts or clinical vignettes. It measures models' ability to generate medically appropriate responses and answer clinical questions in a careful, domain-specific manner. The refinement emphasizes higher-quality or curated examples for more reliable evaluation in medical settings.
reputation: Targeted at clinical NLP research; moderately recognized within medical NLP circles but not a broadly standardized industry benchmark.
